last_cycle_outcome: H78 DONE at the prototype rung, DIVERGENT MODE, ZERO GPU, ~4 min CPU. NOTHING PROMOTED - sota.json untouched, and nothing could be: H78 produces no variant. THE CYCLE SPENT ITSELF MEASURING, WHICH IS WHAT DIVERGENT MODE IS FOR, AND THE MEASUREMENT CHANGED WHAT THE NEXT VARIANT SHOULD BE. THE OBSERVATION: every structural statement this campaign makes about the connectome gap - meta-rule M4, the H22 kill, and findings.md #3's p25=8,290/p50=22,580/p90=87,497 percentiles - comes from experiments/outputs/localsearch_sizing.json, measured on H02's 82.9161% order. The champion is H64 at 84.2582%. 78.9% of that +1.6874 pp gap has since been harvested and NOBODY HAD EVER LOOKED AT THE +0.356498 pp THAT IS LEFT. (a) H78's PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION CONFIRMED: recomputed by the SAME code (imported verbatim from size_localsearch.py) on the champion, gain-distance p50 22,580 -> 10,430, ratio 0.4619, far outside the kill band [0.75,1.25]. BUT SHORTER IS NOT SHORT - p50=10,430 is still 7.6% of n=136,648, W=1000 holds only 18.23% of gain and W=5000 only 36.51% - so M4 SURVIVES NARROWED, amended in place, not overturned. (b) THE REAL RESULT: gain +2.3787 pp / lose +2.0222 pp / net +0.356498 pp. The champion and the reference disagree over 4.40 pp of weight and 85% CANCELS (6.7:1, up from 2.7:1 at the H02 era); 53.6% of nodes carry gain stake; median node displacement 6,051 ranks. That is Q02's flat degenerate near-optimal set, measured for the first time on the champion-vs-reference pair. (c) NO INCREMENTAL PATH, three probes, one answer: the linear rank-blend path runs through a VALLEY of -0.786097 pp at t=0.60 (2.2x the prize, 66x the 0.012 bar); teleporting top-k highest-stake nodes to their reference rank loses at k=1 (-0.011753 pp) and monotonically to -4.737902 pp at k=30,000; and SLOT-PRESERVING adoption - subset re-ordered internally to the reference's opinion with ZERO collateral displacement - has a best proper subset of EXACTLY +0.000000 pp (a no-op) across three selection rules (stake, displacement, seeded random). EVERYTHING THAT CHANGES ANYTHING, LOSES. NEW META-RULE M15-the-reference-is-not-decomposable: the reference's advantage is a property of the WHOLE permutation and of no part of it, so from the champion's basin NO MONOTONE PROCESS reaches it. M15 is ONE MECHANISM FOR FOUR NULLS THE CAMPAIGN ALREADY HAD - M14's 87.7% absorption (cycle 20), H66's 0.000000 pp repair headroom (cycle 19), H31's ILS/LNS null, and the ceiling on every move class since H42. SCOPE STATED IN THE RULE: two geometric families of partial adoption were tested, not all of them, so this is evidential, not a proof; and it is connectome-only because no reference solution exists for microns or mouse. SELF-CORRECTION ON THE RECORD: proto_H78b_path_connectome.json records barrier_confirmed: false and THAT FLAG IS WRONG - the cycle's own rule counted t=0.995 (84.2963%, +0.038146 pp) as 'interior', but that point is the REFERENCE order locally re-sorted, scores 0.318 pp BELOW the reference, and cannot be built without the reference. Left as written in the artifact, corrected in log.md and in M15's instrument_caveat. PROCESS: P23 checked FIRST for the fifth cycle running and still awaiting-operator (HEAD 4dc75ff, no ruling). Cycle 20 named H77 and H76 as items NOT to take and neither was taken. No screen/confirm/critic rung - there is no variant to screen. New items H79, H80, L02.

That is most of the queue: H61, H71, H72, H77, H54 and H67 are all of that shape. They are not auto-killed, but they now need an argument they did not need last week, and M15 predicts each of them is worth <= the +0.018 pp ceiling every move class since H42 has hit. Its option B (measure only H42's microns relabelling dispersion, 5 unguarded runs, ~4.9 h) is the number nobody has and it decides H70, H63, H74 and every future microns variant at once. L02 is the targeted alternative and it is scoped by a measured barrier depth, which is what makes it answerable. _escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
